description.narrative: (China): This activity is in design. Specific interventions will be identified and the IM updated as more is determined...Activities may build urban resilience in China's secondary cities; provide technical support, tools and protocols for greenhouse gas accounting; support pollution reduction efforts in China's urban areas; promote the adoption of international best practices and standards in environmental policies and regulations to mitigate the environmental and social impacts of Chinese infrastructure investments domestically and internationally; and promote the acquisition of U.S. best practices, professional services and technologies to help solve China's extraordinary environmental challenges. Programming aims to enhance green business and economic opportunities for U.S. firms in the large and expanding Chinese market while continuing U.S. government's strategic partnership with China on environmental issues.

Objectives for China: USAID Mekong Safeguards aims to: (i) minimize negative environmental impacts of infrastructure projects by fostering more robust and consistent application of environmental, social, and governance standards; and (ii) encourage decision-makers to avoid unnecessary, harmful infrastructure through smart technologies, system-scale infrastructure planning, and innovations.
